summary: Deployed a Python-based inventory web app (JSON API on /, /api/inventory, /health) on node2 and node3 as OpenRC services listening on port 8080, and configured nginx on node1 as a round-robin HTTP load balancer on port 80 across both backends. Verified traffic distribution, then completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-identity proof and full post-restart recovery (services auto-started, LB restored) at each step.
actions_performed: Installed python3 on node2/node3 and nginx on node1 via apk
Deployed /opt/inventory-app/app.py (stdlib http.server JSON API) to node2 and node3
Created and enabled OpenRC service inventory-app on node2/node3, started and verified on port 8080
Configured /etc/nginx/http.d/default.conf on node1 with upstream inventory_backend (10.100.212.11:8080, 10.100.212.12:8080) and proxy_pass on port 80
Enabled and started nginx on node1; verified nginx config with nginx -t
Verified load-balanced traffic hits both node2 and node3 backends
Captured baseline boot_id and service health for all 3 nodes
Restarted node2 via background 'reboot', confirmed node3 covered all LB traffic during downtime, polled node2 back online, verified new boot_id, service restart, and LB rejoin
Restarted node3 via background 'reboot', confirmed node2 covered all LB traffic during downtime, polled node3 back online, verified new boot_id, service restart, and LB rejoin
Restarted node1 (load balancer) last after both backends were healthy, polled until reachable, verified new boot_id, nginx auto-start, and restored load-balanced traffic across both backends

evidence.summary: OpenRC service inventory-app started on node2; curl to $NODE_IP:8080/health returned {"status":"ok","backend":"node2"}

Captured boot_id 9d4b0e6c..., nginx status started, and successful curl to node1:80/health
Captured boot_id 900af38b..., inventory-app status started, and successful curl to node2:8080/health
Captured boot_id ae28b437..., inventory-app status started, and successful curl to node3:8080/health

evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 03ad9097... confirms restart; inventory-app auto-started and health check passed; LB traffic to node1 shows node2 back in rotation

evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 8c5985be... confirms restart; inventory-app auto-started and health check passed; LB traffic to node1 shows node3 back in rotation alternating with node2

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acknowledged; new boot_id db881a16... confirms restart; nginx auto-started and 8 subsequent requests were correctly load-balanced across both node2 and node3 backends

evidence.requirement: Availability preserved during backend restarts (failover demonstration)
evidence.summary: While node2 was rebooting, all client requests through node1's LB were transparently served by node3, and vice versa while node3 rebooted, demonstrating no loss of service during single-backend restarts
